hard_limits._note: Layer 1. Fixed, never learned. implausible -> ARTIFACT (auto recheck, no page). danger -> ABSOLUTE regardless of baseline (goals of care still apply).

population_defaults._note: Conservative bands used during learning and as the fallback when a stratum has too few samples. Outside the band during learning -> CONFIRM_FIRST (confirm-first widened).

learning._note: Layer 2. Per-patient onboarding window. Baselines per vital x activity_state x time_of_day.

confirm_widening._note: During learning, at_patient_baseline suppression is not allowed (unless clinician_set_baseline). Outside the population band -> CONFIRM_FIRST.

adaptation._note: Layer 3. Rolling robust baseline (weighted median / MAD) with bounds, condition-change resets and a drift guard.

learn_bounds._note: A learned baseline median is clamped inside these bounds (always inside the hard limits); every clamp is logged.

condition_change._note: Partial reset: older samples of the affected vitals keep retain_weight, and a shortened learning period is re-entered. Constraint (validated): relearn_days > retain_weight x rolling_window_days, so that after relearning the new data outweigh a full window of old data.

drift_guard._note: A slow monotonic drift toward abnormal is NOT learned. It is flagged SUBTLE_DETERIORATION_TREND for review, and the drifting samples are excluded from the baseline. Total change = mean of the last k daily rest medians minus the first k in the window (k<=3); samples from the window start onward are excluded once the drift flag is raised (conservative).

unanswered_prompt._note: DECIDED RULE (Wayne 2026-10-17, ST2-009): an unanswered patient-directed confirm prompt (patient call or watch tap-to-confirm) when the patient lives alone counts as a FAILED confirm -> escalate now (confirm_step already_confirmed). Not living alone -> wait for the timeout as before. Caregiver pings are not patient prompts.

chest_pain._note: HT_CHEST_PAIN_VITALS is a parametric rule, replacing the flat 10-min CONFIRM_FIRST, which the clinical owner rejected. ALL VALUES ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Order: hard limits (implausible -> recheck, danger -> ABSOLUTE) -> reliable ECG change -> ABSOLUTE -> per-vital band -> side-specific context modifiers -> symptom modifiers -> safety floors -> band -> output.

vital_bands._note: With chest pain present, population rest thresholds. high: value >= threshold; low: value <= threshold.

modifiers._note: Band shifts: -1 = one band less severe, +1 = one band more severe. Side-specific: *_low applies only when the vital is on its low side, *_high only on its high side.

pacemaker._note: HR at or above the programmed lower rate (within 2 bpm) -> the HR is not banded; below the lower rate -> +1 (possible pacing failure).

known_brady._note: documented usual low HR range; applies when the HR is within the range minus 3 bpm

known_tachy._note: documented usual high HR (e.g. rate-controlled AF); applies when the HR is within the range max + 10 bpm

concordance._note: discordant may only lower band B or C; it never lowers A

device_reliability._note: A quality-flagged vital is not banded and the output becomes a recheck (CONFIRM_FIRST device_recheck) unless the reliable inputs already give band A.

safety._note: Context can lower a raw band by at most 2 and can never turn raw band A into log-only. Hard danger limits (HT_VS_DANGER) and a reliable ECG change are always ABSOLUTE (goals of care still apply).
